title: The continuous integral coefficient telescope after pullback to a scheme
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a normed field over ℚ_ℓ and X a scheme. Set R=condensedRingObj(integralCoeff ℓ E) X and S=condensedRingObj(C(E)) X, using def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients. There is a sequential diagram D of R-modules with colimit cocone c, isomorphisms e_n:D_n≅R and p:c.pt≅Res(S), such that ℓ^n times e_n inverse followed by the nth leg equals e_0 inverse followed by the zeroth leg. The latter leg followed by p has underlying map the actual coefficient inclusion R→S.

proof.text: Reuse the explicit continuous-function localization diagram and its proved colimit from lem-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-scalar-exact. Apply the coefficient sheafification/pullback functor and scalar transport. These functors preserve the sequential colimit.

Normalize its stages using the regular-module comparison and its point using restriction of scalars. Coefficient naturality identifies the zeroth leg with the coefficient inclusion. On each compact profinite test ℓ times leg n+1 is leg n by cancellation in E; functoriality and induction give the displayed ℓ^n identity.

proof_origin.note: A4 stage-3 reduction; coefficient telescope and denominator calculation are proved, sequential Hom continuity is the remaining geometric input.
